Definition: from an obsolete particle νή‐ (implying negation) and G2031; not speaking, i.e. an infant (minor); figuratively, a simple-minded person, an immature Christian:--babe, child (+ -ish).
BiblicalUsage: A babe in the New Testament is not just a small child; it is someone who cannot yet take solid food. Jesus thanks the Father that the deep things are hidden from the wise and revealed to babes, while Paul calls the Corinthians babes in Christ because they still need milk instead of meat.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God delights to give truth to the humble, and I hold that growing up in Christ means learning to chew what once I could only swallow. The babes receive what the wise miss, and that is why Jesus thanks the Father for it.
